name: Modern CLI Tools
description: Installs modern CLI replacements and TUI tools: bat, ripgrep, fd, fzf, eza, zoxide, neovim, tmux, lazygit, ast-grep, jujutsu, and zellij.

install.description: Comma-separated list of tools to install (e.g. 'bat,ripgrep,fzf'). When set, only the listed tools are installed. When empty (default), all tools are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (e.g. 'neovim,tmux'). When set, the listed tools are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.
